context: A regular customer chats with the barista about dinner plans
purpose: Teach: 鶏/調理/放題/代金/飲食/定員/ピーク/支払う

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 葵さん、今夜うちの家族で鶏料理のお店に行く予定なんですよ。
lines.en: Aoi, my family is going to a chicken restaurant tonight.
lines.style: Warm friendly tone with relaxed familiar pacing throughout the line.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: わあ、いいですね!飲食店巡り、お好きなんですか?食べ放題のお店ですか?
lines.en: Oh nice! Do you enjoy trying out restaurants? Is it all-you-can-eat?
lines.style: Bright cheerful barista voice with curious upward inflection here.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いや食べ放題じゃなくて、調理を目の前でしてくれる本格的なお店なんだ。
lines.en: Not all-you-can-eat, a proper place where they cook right in front of you.
lines.style: Proud dad explaining with slight excitement and gentle smile.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 素敵!でも金曜日のピーク時は混みますよね。予約はされましたか?
lines.en: Lovely! But Friday peak hours get crowded. Did you make a reservation?
lines.style: Cheerful but slightly cautious, raising concern with kind smile.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ええ、先週電話したらもう定員ぎりぎりで、なんとか席を確保できたよ。
lines.en: Yeah, when I called last week they were nearly at capacity, but I got seats.
lines.style: Relieved chuckle, slow deliberate pace of an older man speaking.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: よかったですね!お値段の方はどんな感じのお店なんですか?
lines.en: Glad to hear it! What kind of price range is the place?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, casual conversational rhythm with light laugh.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: コースで一人五千円くらいかな。今夜は私が代金を支払うつもりだよ。
lines.en: About five thousand yen per person for the course. Tonight I'm paying the bill.
lines.style: Warm fatherly pride with a soft chuckle at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: わあ、太っ腹ですね!ご家族との時間、楽しんできてくださいね。
lines.en: Wow, so generous! Please enjoy your time with the family.
lines.style: Bright sincere send-off with warm smile and bow in voice.
